name: prism-geo-monorepo
description: PrismGEO: track how AI assistants name your brand (self-hosted, open source)

scripts.extension:zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/prismgeo-capture.zip && cd apps/extension && zip -r -X ../../dist/prismgeo-capture.zip . -x '*.DS_Store' -x 'README.md'
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/db && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/crawler && tsc --noEmit -p packages/mcp && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
